chemistry.notes: Estimated: platform sibling with the same pack. The 2026 RZ 550e on file has the same 76.96 kWh gross pack and its chemistry rests on the Toyota chief engineer (Autopian): same NMC chemistry and cells as the bZ pack.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: platform sibling with the same pack. The 2026 RZ 550e on file has the same 76.96 kWh gross pack; Toyota chief engineer (InsideEVs): the bZ pack "still runs on a 400-volt electrical architecture".

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: TFLcar: DC "up to 150 kW" for the TZ overall, and InsideEVs gives 150 kW for the large pack only; no page states the peak for the 77 kWh pack specifically.
